c17.note: TalkEsport (Oct 30, 2026) says Discord is still private and its paperwork hasn't been made public; consistent with other trackers.

c18.note: Article says no new date has been reported and that Discord hasn't said why the March target slipped; stockmarketwatch says no announced IPO as of Nov 2026.

c19.note: The 15-day public-filing rule is correct SEC practice, and the article states this conclusion as of Oct 30; a listing could occur no sooner than weeks out.

c23.note: The SEC document is a Form D Notice of Exempt Offering for CIK 1763840 (Discord Inc.), with accession 0001567619-23-005083 consistent with a 2023 filing; the first sale date is 2023-01-17.

c25.note: Bloomberg, TechCrunch and TalkEsport all report Discord saying it has over 200 million monthly users.

c26.note: TechCrunch states last valued at $14.7B in the 2021 round raising $500M; other sources round it to about $15B.

c6.note: The Markets.com page is dated Sep 1, 2026, but its article text didn't load, so I couldn't read its wording directly. Other sources back the claim: Discord filed confidentially in Jan 2026 (Bloomberg) and no date, ticker or price was set. TalkEsport on Oct 30, 2026 describes the IPO as stalled.

c30.note: The 2021 Series I round raised about $500M at about $15B ($14.7B in some reports). Filings show $550.62 per share before a stock split; Forge lists it as $55.06 adjusted for the split. TalkEsport (Oct 2026) reports current fund and secondary marks of $23.51–$36.79, all below $55.06.
